contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #034: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity.

Let f:U->Z be a surjective projective holomorphic morphism of smooth connected compact Kahler manifolds, dim Z=b>=1, dim U=b+e with e>=1. Let beta=f^*G+c1(Lambda) be Kahler, G real Bott-Chern (1,1), Lambda a rational holomorphic line, and w=integral over a general fiber of beta^e. Divisible j clear the denominators of Lambda.

definitions.vol: Analytic volume of a real (1,1) class, normalized as its top intersection for a nef class

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 034 (Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity.; papers: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity; Uniform indices for semi-log-canonical log Calabi–Yau pairs; Conditional good minimal models for compact Kähler fourfolds; Log abundance in characteristic zero; Minimal metrics and interior injectivity for nef adjoints; Fourfold nonvanishing by minimal metrics and moving jets; Lifting sections from the reduced support of an adjoint; Schnell fiber spaces and good canonical models; Uniform log Iitaka fibrations and bounded moduli denominators; Uniform Pluricanonical Iitaka Fibrations; Relative denominators and effective systems for log Calabi-Yau fibrations; Arithmetic Stein-degree bounds for log Calabi–Yau pairs; Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations for fourfolds; Abundance after nonvanishing for compact Kähler fourfolds; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

The printed nv:direct-image holds with its exact hypotheses: R_j=w*j^e/e!+O(j^(e-1)); B0=G+lim c1(det f_*O(jLambda))/(jR_j)=f_*(beta^(e+1))/((e+1)w) is pseudo-effective; integral_U beta^(b+e)<=(e+1)^b*w*vol_Z(B0). Limits are in real Bott-Chern cohomology.
The printed rank and determinant limits in nv:direct-image follow from relative ampleness, relative Serre vanishing and proper analytic Riemann-Roch, without flatness or connectedness of fibers.

If g:V->Z is a proper equidimensional holomorphic map of a reduced pure (b+e)-dimensional analytic space to a smooth b-dimensional base, with all fibers of dimension e, and alpha is a smooth locally ambient semipositive closed (1,1) form, then g_*(alpha^(e+1) cap [V]) has zero Lelong numbers everywhere. In particular this applies to the equidimensional main transform before resolving it.

For a modification p:Zprime->Z of smooth compact complex manifolds, positive closed (1,1) currents S and Sprime with p_*Sprime=S and zero Lelong numbers of Sprime satisfy p^*S=Sprime+[D] for an effective p-exceptional real divisor D. Hence their classes satisfy Bprime=p^*B-[D].

For every surjective projective morphism of smooth connected compact Kahler manifolds of relative dimension e>=1 and base dimension b>=1, every nef real (1,1) class beta with w=integral_fiber beta^e>0 satisfies vol_U(beta)<=(e+1)^b*w*vol_Z(f_*(beta^(e+1))/((e+1)w)). No rational splitting, flatness, smoothness of the morphism, or projectivity of the base is required.

For a positive log-concave sequence I_0,...,I_b, one has I_b<=I_0*(I_1/I_0)^b. The propagation identity I_k*Q_k=I_(k+1)*Q_(k-1)+I_1*(I_k^2-I_(k-1)*I_(k+1)), where Q_k=I_1*I_k-I_0*I_(k+1), proves the successive-ratio step universally.

The universal constant (e+1)^b in C34-VOLUME cannot be decreased, even for ample rational classes on projective bundles over P^b: on P_{P^b}(O(1) plus O^e), beta=xi+tH for rational t>0 has w=1, B=(t+1/(e+1))H and integral beta^(e+b)=sum_{i=0}^b binom(e+b,i)t^i; the ratio to w*vol(B) tends to (e+1)^b as t decreases to zero.

For every rational-divisor approximation actually displayed in nv:diagonal-mass, f:U->Z satisfies all hypotheses of nv:direct-image with b=d,e=d-1,G=2M,Lambda=s*h^*O_E(1)-O_U(Dprime). Thus its rank, determinant and volume conclusions apply with no further smooth-fibration or projective-base assumption. This does not certify existence of the approximation or the remaining diagonal-mass argument.

Printed thm:main: assuming logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity for smooth projective pairs with reduced SNC boundary, every analytically nef rational-Cartier lc adjoint K_X+Delta on a normal irreducible compact Kahler space is semiample. Not verified in this mission.

Printed nv:meromorphic: if X is a smooth connected compact Kahler manifold with a(X)=0 and no positive-dimensional proper compact analytic subvariety through a very general point, then some positive canonical power has a nonzero meromorphic section. Not verified in this mission.

The other load-bearing program, boundary, projective-good-model, and signed-descent arguments needed to deduce thm:main from the projective subadditivity assumption and nv:meromorphic are valid. Unresolved outside this mission.

The slope, point-pole, two-slot-volume, rational approximation, diagonal selection and final determinant-descent arguments needed for nv:meromorphic beyond nv:direct-image are valid. Unresolved outside this mission.

external_assumptions.statement: For a projective holomorphic map, a rational line bundle ample on every fiber is relatively ample after clearing denominators; relative Serre vanishing kills higher direct images for sufficiently large powers, uniformly over a compact base.
external_assumptions.source: Relative Kodaira ampleness criterion and relative Serre vanishing in complex analytic projective geometry; treated as explicit standard external inputs. A precise primary proposition was not obtained in this scope lookup.

external_assumptions.statement: Proper analytic direct image is compatible with the Riemann-Roch transformation; for smooth compact complex manifolds its cohomological normalization is ch(Rf_*E) td(Z)=f_*(ch(E) td(U)).

external_assumptions.locator: Opening unnumbered Riemann-Roch theorem, p. 149, parts (a) and (b)

external_assumptions.statement: A proper projective holomorphic map over a smooth compact base admits a projective base modification whose reduced main transform is equidimensional. The base modification can be made smooth by blowups; a smooth projective resolution of the main transform can be chosen, and all resulting smooth spaces are compact Kahler.
external_assumptions.source: Analytic projective flattening and resolution theorem, Hironaka (1975), with Kahler stability of blowups. Exact original flattening passage was unavailable; retained as an explicit uncited external input, not replaced by Barlet Theorem 4.1.1, which alone does not assert projectivity.

routes.retired_because: Pseudo-effectivity does not imply nefness: the exceptional curve class on the blowup of P2 at a point has negative intersection with itself. No argument may substitute this implication for zero-Lelong regularization.

Zero Lelong numbers before flattening are false: for U=P^e times Bl_z(P^b), beta=H_f+H-delta*E, and f the blowdown composed with projection, the normalized original fiber-integral current has Lelong number delta at z. The fiber dimension there is e+b-1; proof.md equation (25) treats this exact admissible example.
